Privacy notice

We use the details you send through this form to understand your requirement and to respond to your request. We ask only for the information needed for that purpose.

Please do not include passwords, payment details, or other sensitive information. This is a short statement of how we intend to use your details. A full privacy policy has not been published on this site yet.

What happens after you send your request

The time needed depends on what you ask for, so we do not promise a fixed response time.

  1. 1

    We review your request

    We read what you have sent and consider what the project involves.

  2. 2

    We follow up if needed

    If we need more detail, we will contact you with questions or suggest a short conversation.

  3. 3

    You receive a response

    We prepare a response, such as a quotation or a recommended approach, for you to consider. Nothing is agreed until you approve it.
